description:
tier 3 of the phase 4 test suite: the clip-level computeStabilization
contract plus real-fixture evidence on both xiaomi clips.

synthetic pins (9 cases):
- mode Off is identity + zoom 1 + status Off for every frame, zero cost
- the refusal ladder: empty series -> NoImu, unknown offset -> Unsynced,
  missing intrinsics -> NoImu, no frames -> empty result
- LowOverlap flags frames outside the gyro span while LockFirstFrame
  makes the clamp direction observable (angles 10/0/20/30 deg)
- Smooth at the default strength 0.5 is an exact no-op on the frame
  grid (tau = 31.6 us -> alpha = 1); strength 0.95 smooths for real
- LockFirstFrame pins the first inside frame (1 deg/frame pan)
- HorizonLock levels a rolled camera (pure roll block, requiredZoom ==
  the roll closed form) and degrades to plain Smooth (flagged) without
  usable gravity
- the zoom-limit clamp keeps requiredZoom honest: app
